item.title: "Ore-igami" Bloomery Iron Melting Furnace Demo
item.description:
The Guild is excited to host our first bloomery demonstration at the park! A bloomery is a small earth furnace where charcoal, fire and iron ore combine to create a “bloom” of iron metal. This ancient process produces real wrought iron, just as it was made before modern furnaces existed.

Join us to witness this fascinating piece of history in action and see how iron was crafted centuries ago. Don’t miss this unique opportunity to experience the roots of blacksmithing!

item.title: 40th Anniversary Celebration
item.description:
🔥 The Western Canadian Blacksmith’s Guild 40th Anniversary Celebration 🔥

Join us July 10–12 as we celebrate 40 years of blacksmithing, friendship, and craftsmanship!

🏕️ Camping on site (no hookups)

🔥 Campfires, camaraderie, and a weekend full of smithing activities

📅 Friday, July 10

• Informal meet and greet in the evening

• Camping on site

• Hot dogs and smokies around the campfire

• BYO food and drinks

📅 Saturday, July 11

item.title: Annual General Meeting
item.description: Our annual general meeting. The AGM will occur at one of the shop buildings on the LWAS site. We will discuss guild matters and vote on initiatives and policies. Afterwards we usually do some smithing.

item.title: Deep Freeze Byzantine Winter Festival Demo
item.description:
Members of the guild will be demonstrating at the Deep Freeze Byzantine Winter Festival in Edmonton.

The demo will be at 12:00pm-8:30pm Saturday, and 12:00pm-6:00PM Sunday.

item.title: LWAS Annual Exposition Event Day 2
item.description:
The largest LWAS event of the year, the Expo will feature concessions, a vintage tractor pull competition, animal interaction, face painting, music events, vintage vehicle parade, demonstrations, historic buildings and displays.

We will be attending to provide smithing demonstrations to the public.

item.title: LWAS Country Lights
item.description: Country Lights is back at the LWAS grounds. The park gets lit up for the season and we’ll have the forge going in the blacksmith shop in the evenings. Come warm up by the fire and see some smithing.

item.title: LWAS Spring Fire Up Event Day 1
item.description:
The Western Canadian Blacksmithing Guild will be participating in LWAS’s 35th Anniversary event at the Alberta Heritage Exposition Park! This family-friendly event features a Vintage Tractor Pull, BBQ Competition, Swap Meet, historic displays, and more.

Our club will be hosting live blacksmithing demonstrations on Saturday and Sunday – a perfect chance to showcase your skills, inspire new enthusiasts, and connect with fellow members. We encourage all members to come out for the event.

item.title: LWAS Tractor Pull & Swap Meet Day 1
item.description:
Back at the LWAS grounds for the spring tractor pull and swap meet. There’s also a BBQ competition running all weekend, so come hungry. We’ll be in the shop doing demos both days, and members are welcome to come out and take a turn at the forge.

For more on the event, see the LWAS page.

item.description: This is a great opportunity to visit the park and to get a glimpse behind the scenes. Find out all about volunteering at Leduc West - whether you’re 8 or 80 there is a place for you! The Guild will be there and provide blacksmithing demonstrations during the event.

item.title: WCBG Annual General Meeting
item.description: Our yearly AGM. We’ll go over the past year, look at the budget, plan events for the year ahead and hold elections. Members, please try to make it out. Your vote counts. If there is time after the meeting, we sometimes light the forges and get some smithing in too.
